evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic urgency: the matched-clause framing converts a cadence decision into a felt stakes claim, performing high-arousal negative valence — alarm that an unrehearsed rollback is no rollback at all.

mints.name: StakesAsAphoristicUrgency
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker converting a procedural decision into felt urgency through aphoristic framing that makes the absence feel like a loss already incurred?
